answer_1.quote: Direct speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) refers to translating source language speech directly into target language speech using an end-to-end model... S2ST extends S2TT which further generates the target speech.

answer_2.quote: employ two evaluation metrics: ASR-BLEU and BLASER 2.0... calculates the BLEU score and the statistical significance of translation results using the SacreBLEU toolkit.
